authority.acceptance_standard: the production target = Prototype v5 plus the explicit production deltas required by the final handoff
authority.rule: Prototype screenshot comparison is mandatory, BUT visual acceptance is against the normative production target. The Prototype is the primary visual and composition baseline, not the ceiling. A candidate never becomes acceptable by reproducing a Prototype defect or omission.

precedence.role: NORMATIVE. Explicit requirements here override Prototype rough edges, omissions and implementation limitations.

PRIMARY VISUAL AND COMPOSITION BASELINE for geometry, visual hierarchy, palette, typography, spacing, composition, domain grammar and desktop/mobile gestalt — unless a rank 1 production delta applies.
INTENT AND CONSTRAINT CLARIFICATION. These are not discarded merely because the Prototype's JS or CSS failed to implement an intended production behaviour.

authority.measurement_note: Every quantitative value below was verified against the Prototype by capturing it in Chrome and reading computed geometry. Divergences between what the Prototype does and what production must do are enumerated in `divergences`, each with prototype_observed, production_target, authority_source and rationale.
authority.superseded_rule: An earlier revision of this contract let the Prototype implementation override the written authority wherever the two disagreed. That was wrong and is not the project contract. Written authority takes precedence; a Prototype omission or defect is never a production target.

strength_scale.explicit-normative: A quoted imperative in html-share-ui-v5-to-implementation-master-handoff.md sections 6-11, which the handoff itself declares are production requirements.
strength_scale.explicit-candidate: Named in the html-share-ui-v5-to-implementation-master-handoff.md section 11 motion candidate list, under the unconditional section 6.1 requirement to retain semantic motion.
strength_scale.intent-doc: Asserted only by DESIGN-DECISIONS.md / INFORMATION-PRESERVATION.md / REVIEW-v5.md. Not discarded because the Prototype failed to implement it, but weaker than a handoff imperative.
strength_scale.derived-from-principle: No direct statement; follows from a general handoff rule such as "do not cut information to shorten a page".
strength_scale.SILENT: No authority states a requirement. Recorded so the silence is visible rather than filled in by assumption.

motion_contract.authority: html-share-ui-v5-to-implementation-master-handoff.md §11 Motion (normative candidate list and requirements); §6.1 "semantic motionを維持"; DESIGN-DECISIONS.md and REVIEW-v5.md for intent
motion_contract.note: V0 defines and classifies only. No motion is implemented or asserted in V0. Classification is drawn from the written authority, NOT from which keyframes happened to execute in the Prototype.
universal_requirements: no CDN or external runtime dependency
motion_contract.reduced_motion_rule: prefers-reduced-motion is mandatory wherever production motion is required. A required behaviour must remain fully usable with motion suppressed.
motion_contract.prototype_implementation_not_to_be_copie: html-share-ui-v5-to-implementation-master-handoff.md §11 "PrototypeのJS patch implementationそのものをproductionへコピーしない。"

behaviours.caveat: html-share-ui-v5-to-implementation-master-handoff.md L918 lists browser history / deep link / sharing policy as an UNDECIDED architecture decision, and the parked history fix is unmerged. Cross-route transition is coupled to that decision and must not be treated as settled.

behaviours.production_target: Not required. No authority names it, and a generic entry stagger with no semantic payload is the closest thing in the Prototype to the decorative ambient animation the handoff says is unnecessary. If a future phase adopts it anyway, the animation-delay defect must not be carried over.
behaviours.authority_source: No motion list names it (html-share-ui-v5-to-implementation-master-handoff.md L861-L869, DESIGN-DECISIONS.md, REVIEW-v5.md are all silent). Nearest statement is html-share-ui-v5-to-implementation-master-handoff.md L876 "decorative ambient animationは不要".

behaviours.prototype_observed: ABSENT. There is no continuity treatment between a plan record and its trip.

behaviours.prototype_observed: ABSENT as motion. Switching to 旅行中 toggles display on the next-move block, a hard cut. The v4 code path that wrapped this in a view transition is dead because v5 replaced the travel DOM.

at least one non-Research domain surface

research.overview.domain_grammar: Two explicit Project workspaces beside a visually subordinate exploration surface, then a task/context workspace. The Project-vs-exploration boundary is the point of the route.

desktop.primary_first_fold: Both Project cards with their six state rows, beside the exploration surface with its four exploration rows.

sections.why: Project workspaces and the exploration surface must both be present.

section_order.production_note: The Prototype's secondary column here is the Relation model panel, which html-share-ui-v5-to-implementation-master-handoff.md L347-L353 deletes. It is deliberately NOT matched.

critical_first_screen: first Project identity and its current state
mobile.hierarchy_note: Straight three-then-two stack, order preserved. Fixed label columns (82px exploration, 76px state) are NOT overridden on mobile, leaving ~260px for values.

investment.dashboard.domain_grammar: A dominant portfolio summary, an allocation figure that encodes share quantitatively, and a divergent P/L figure that encodes gain and loss in opposite directions from a zero rule. Every figure states its denominator.

at least one item needing attention

investment.pulse.domain_grammar: A judgment surface, explicitly NOT a quantitative dashboard: 次回確認 emphasised at the top, then the items needing action or review. Movers use the Dashboard diverging grammar. The half-width detail table is abolished in favour of a compact ranked list.

scope.statement: This is a VISUAL ACCEPTANCE contract keyed on the 15 UX destinations. It is NOT a canonical page-topology decision.
scope.quote: Prototype UXが15 destinationになったからといって、productionをそのまま15 static canonicalにしてはいけない。
scope.rationale: The handoff explicitly forbids inferring the production canonical page count from the Prototype UX destination count. V1 must not read this contract as settling topology.

source_truth_constraints.note: Explicit non-promotion clauses. These constrain DATA, not pixels, so this visual harness does not check them. V1 must honour them at the renderer and model layer.

constraints.requirement: Prefer deterministic heading extraction from the Research KB body. Do not canonicalise opaque AI-generated summary text.
The shopping intent gradient is a future candidate only. Current source has no complete contract for it, so it must not be promoted into production data.
Do not bake the Prototype fixed slots (往路 / 復路 / 宿 / 乗車券) into the production data model. Model bookings as repeatable records.
constraints.note: This forbids the SCHEMA, not the visual grouping of confirmed rows.

constraints.requirement: Do not present a leading or example item as highest priority when source carries no priority contract.
Do not let position price P/L read as complete portfolio cost-basis P/L. The Prototype footnote satisfies this and must be preserved.
現在地 and 次の一手 are human-managed Notion properties. No automatic AI writeback.
